tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (nya)༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i tho chung rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba kun gyi chos dbyings
(nya)༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i tho chung rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba kun gyi chos dbyings

tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i tho chung rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal ba kun gyi chos dbyings ye shes khams// gdul bya'i tshe dang las dang bsod nams sogs// rgyas par spel phyir gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa'i// bla ma 'chi bdag 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal// de yi go 'phang sgrub thabs cho ga'i rim// rgyud dang sngon rabs mkhas pa'i gzhung mang dang*// khyad par rje btsun mchog gi dgongs pa ltar// 'khrul med go bde'i ngag gis bshad kyis nyon// kun rig gzhan phan mtha' yas nyid// gzhir bzhag mi 'dra'i khyad par chos// rnam gsal rin chen sgron ma 'di// nye bar gtad pas don kun 'grub// 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i sgrub pa po rnams kyis 'di'i cho ga nyams su len par byed pa la/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i kun rig cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas gzhir bzhag nas/ 'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams ni/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes 'jug pa'i phyag rgya ni khro bo ti rinti'i phyag rgya ma gtogs mchod pa byin rlabs sogs kun rig dang 'dra/ sems bskyed pa'i skabs su'ang phyag rgya de nyid dang*/ de ma rtog pa'i sems can thams cad 'chi bdag gi chad pa las thar bar bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i cho ga nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum bya/ swa bhā was stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang sngon zhi ba'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsam/

de'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa/ sku mdog sngon po sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag lhag ma rnams kyis ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ rgyu ma dang mgo thod shas gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams la/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad pa'i mthe'u chung gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis sdigs mdzub tu byas pa gnas gsum du reg cing*/ oṃ badzra satwa kro dha a na lārka ma hā badzra kro dha/ drwa ba drwa ba/ bi drwa ba bi drwa ba/ sarba a pa ya/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra/ pra ṇā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis bdag bsrung*/ yang lan gsum brjod la/ dang po'i 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ gnyis pas rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pa/ gsum pas de'i nang du rdo rje'i gur bsams la gnas bsrung*/ yang lan gsum brjod pas rnal 'byor bsrung bar bsams te/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o// spro na/ chos nyid stong pa nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar bya/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chog go /srung 'khor rgyas par byed na gzhan phan mtha' yas ltar ro// de nas rang gi lag mthil gnyis su sogs lag pa byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bskur ba'i bar 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa sku mdog dkar po rab tu dgyes pa'i man chad 'dra'o// tshangs pa chen po sogs gzhung bzhin brjod pa'am/ yang na/ bdag nyid kyi smin mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros/ des 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas te/

mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par sems can thams cad 'chi bdag gi chad pa las thar bar byas nas/ tshe dang las dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byas/ 'od zer slar 'dus bdag nyid la thim/ zhes brjod de ltar don byas pa'i sems can rnams kyis bdag la mchod bstod byas par bsams la/ sngags mchod dang*/ mtshan brgyas bstod do// yang na mtshan brgya'i tshab tu/ khyod ni glang po'i rna ba can// khyod ni seng ge'i lta stangs can// khyod ni mi lce 'bar ba can// khyod ni bden pa'i sprin yin te// khyod ni pha ltar slob pa yin// khyod ni ma ltar slob pa yin// khyod ni brtan pa'i sa yang yin// khyod ni chu bo'i gzhung yang yin// khyod ni 'thor byed rlung yang yin// khyod ni rin chen 'byung gnas mdzod// ces mtshan bcus bstod kyang rung ste/ spyod rgyud nas gsungs pa'i ko ṭa kṣa la sogs pa'i don 'gyur yin zhing*/ tshig ris 'di ji lta ba bzhin sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud las kyang gsungs so// rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ puṇye sogs bkod la/ de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba rnams kyi tshe dang las dang bsod nams sogs rgyas par byas/ slar 'dus snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ puṇye puṇye ma hā puṇye a pa ri mi ta ā yur pu ṇya dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsa ya ka ri ni swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzlas la/ 'od zer/ oṃ bhrum̐ badzra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ ces pa'ang ci nus bzla ba mus chen gsungs/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang las dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod do// gsol gdab 'di 'og las sbyar dang brtan bzhugs dang*/

dngos grub blang ba rnams la yang 'di nyid kha spo bar bya'o// brtan byed kyi yig brgya dang mchod bstod sogs kun rig bzhin bya'o// bsnyen pa sogs bdag bskyed rkyang pa'i tshe rjes bdag nyid la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs kyi sngags rgyas dbang bskur ba dang*/ oṃ bhṛ ta sogs kyi sngags rgyas sgo gsum byin gyi brlab/ oṃ badzra satwa kro dha sogs kyi sngags rgyas bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum gyi bar chad bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'chi bdag 'joms pa 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba sogs kyi smon lam gdab// bsnyen pa ni thun mtshams gsum mam gnyis su bcad nas sngags 'bum phrag gsum mam drug bzla'o// dgongs thun gyi rjes su cha gsum gtor ma btang ngo*// gnyis pa mdun bskyed sgrub pa la gnyis las/ dang po bum pa sgrub cing mchod pa la/ rnam rgyal bum pa tshul bzhin du bcas la/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng tu bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang bar bsam la/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'i dbus su lha bcu gsum gyi gnas su padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du skad cig gis dbus su bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa sku mdog dkar po sogs dang*/ shar du mi 'khrugs pa nas/ byang du rdo rje dril bu'i bar lha bcu gsum zhal phyag rdzogs par skad cig gis zhal phyag 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa sogs kun rig bzhin bya/ badzra sngon du 'gro bas dbang bskur/ sngags mchod/ chos dbyings ye shes las byung zhing zhes sogs lha bcu gsum gyi bstod pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ sngags bzla ba'i dmigs pa kun rig bzhin no// bzlas bya'i sngags ni/

oṃ puṇye sogs/ gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ 'khor gyi sngags/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwā nañtsa swā hā/ oṃ ratne ratne ma hā ratne/ ratna saṃ bha we/ ratna ki ra ne ratna mā la bi shuddhe sho ddha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ tra tha/ oṃ a mi te/ a mi tod bha we/ a mi ta saṃ bha we/ a mi ta bi krān te/ a mi ta ga mi ni/ sarba karma kle sha kṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ oṃ a mo gha a pra ti ha ta sarba a wa ra ṇa bi nā sha ni/ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas rigs bzhi dang*/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trāṃ/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ lha mo bzhi dang*/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha sogs sgo ba bzhi'i sngags rnams ci nus bzla zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs ci nus bzla/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas la ye shes pa gshegs/ dung chos kyi chu blugs pa yi ge brgya pa bzla ba sogs kun rig bzhin no// gsum pa dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa la/ mdun gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bgegs bsal/ oṃ sha/ ces dang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ ces pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ bha yongs su gyur pa las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba la steng nas drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/

gdugs dang*/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pas mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ de'i phyi rol du khyams kha dog sna tshogs pa'i phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba dang 'od zer phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o// gzhal yas khang gi nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng thog rim par phub cing dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo ba'i steng du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte ba dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs dang*/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi dang sgo bzhir padma dang zla ba'i gdan re re bsam/ dkyil thang phal cher rtsig pa phyogs mdog kun rig dang mthun pa mang la phyag len yang de ltar mdzad pa mang nas rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhi sngo ser sogs/ de bzhin lha snam shar sngo sogs byas pas chog ste dkyil thang dang bstun/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oṃ puṇye sogs yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje thugs kar stod de 'dzin cing g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa zhi ba'i nyams can/ zla ba'i 'od dang zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ rtsibs bzhi la shar du oṃ kaṃ ka ni sogs yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa/ lhor oṃ ratne sogs nas rin 'byung*/ nub tu oṃ a mi te sogs nas 'od dpag med/ byang du oṃ a mo gha sogs nas don yod grub pa/ de bzhi ka'ang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya can/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga po thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs can no// de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir/

shar lhor hūm̐ las bdug pa ma dkar mo sogs trāṃ hrīḥlas me stag ma sogs bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlas sgo ba bzhi bskyed pa'am/ bdug spos ma man chad/ shar lhor oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐ las bdug pa ma dkar mo bdug spos 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis lha mo bzhi dang*/ shar sgor oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dza las rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐ las rdo rje zhags pa sogs kyis bskyed pa mus chen gyis gsungs pas de ltar byas kyang legs/ bdug spos ma la sogs pa'i lha de dag thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa nas skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar kun rig bzhin bya/ 'dir sgo ba bzhi po cung zad khro bo'i nyams dang ldan pa'o// zhes dam tshig pa bskyed nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa lha bcu gsum rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas spyan 'dren kun rig bzhin 'don las/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbha ga wān badzra e hye hi sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes pa khyad par ro// byon legs/ khrus gsol/ gdan 'bul/ mchod pa/ phyag dgug gzhug gnas gsum byin rlabs/ dbu rgyan rang chas can du bsam pa rnams ni kun rig bzhin no// phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha sprad pa dku g.yon du bzhag ngag tu oṃ puṇye

'di tshul 'ong pas rtsa rig gsungs/ sogs brjod/ 'jug tu gar skor bya zhing swā hā'i bar brjod pa ni las rgya/ dam rgya gtso bo la rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang mtha' bzhi sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ puṇye sogs brjod pa ni chos rgya/ de'i tshe gtso bo'i sku la rtog cing yid la byed pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o// phyag rgya bkrol nas thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pas sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang las dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces dang*/ se gol gtogs pa ni las sbyar ro// de bzhin du rdo rje khu tshur kha sprad nas puṇye'i sngags brjod pa'i bar gyi las rgya ni thams cad 'dra la/ mi 'khrugs pa sogs bzhi la kun rig sbyong rgyal la sogs pa bzhi'i phyag rgya'am/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon skyabs sbyin lan bzhi bskyar ba'ang bshad/ gong ltar yang oṃ kaṃ ka ni sogs rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ oṃ ratne sogs rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ oṃ a mi te sogs 'od dpag med dang*/ oṃ a mo gha sogs don yod grub pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs bzhis kyang sems can thams cad sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ puṇye dang oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐ rdo rje bdug spos ma sogs bzhi'i dam rgya dang*/ puṇye dang oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥrdo rje lcags kyu sogs sgo ba bzhi'i dam rgya dang chos rgya sogs kun rig bzhin las sbyar gong dang 'dra/ 'dir las rgya'i puṇye'i tshab tu rtsa rig bshad pa'ang yod/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa nas brtsams te thams cad kun rig bzhin no// dbyangs snyan pa'i bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bstod pa chos rje kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/ chos dbyings ye shes las byung zhing*// rnam snang chen po'i ngo bo nyid// gti mug sbyong mdzad sangs rgyas sku// phyag 'tshal 'chi bdag 'joms byed la// me long ye shes las byung zhing*// mi bskyod rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid// zhe sdang 'joms mdzad rdo rje'i thugs// phyag 'tshal mi 'khrugs rgyal po la// mnyam nyid ye shes las byung zhing*// rin chen 'byung ldan ngo bo nyid// ser sna sbyong mdzad yon tan mchog

/phyag 'tshal rin chen tog khyod la// sor rtog ye shes las byung zhing*// 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo nyid// 'dod chags sbyong mdzad padma'i gsung*// phyag 'tshal tshe dpag med mgon la// bya grub ye shes las byung zhing*// don yod grub pa'i ngo bo nyid// phrag dog sbyong mdzad phrin las bdag /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la// sprin bzhin rdo rje bdug pa ma// sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la'i bar kun rig bzhin no// cha gsum dang rigs drug yi dwags rnams la gtor ma sbyin pa kun rig bzhin bya'o// gsum pa 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ 'jug pa'i chos bcu bdun dang dbang bcu dgu po kun rig dang 'dra ba las/ mi 'dra ba'i sgos chos ni/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i oṃ badzra sa ma ya'i tshe/ ti rinti'i phyag rgyas 'jug me tog 'dor sngags/ sangs rgyas dngos grub nas bzhes su gsol/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hūm̐ gis dor/ sngags dbang la/ oṃ puṇye puṇye sogs lha bcu gsum gyi sngags dang*/ oṃ sha oṃ bhas dbang bskur/ bum dbang man la oṃ badzra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes sogs badzra sngon du 'gro bas bya/ 'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsung gi tshab tu/ 'grub 'gyur phyag na rdo rje gsung*// zhes brjod do// deng nas brtsams te bdag bran sogs kyi rjes su lha bcu gsum gyi sngags cung zad cig bzlas la/ ti rinti'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra dha ra sogs lan gsum dang*/ mthar rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i rnam pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phyir 'thon te rang gnas su 'khod par bsams la/ lha bcu gsum gyi sngags ci nus dang slar yang gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ brtan bzhugs bya ba dang*/ gsol btab bdag bskyed bzhin bya'o// de rjes gzhan dbang bskur ba dang rab gnas sogs gzhan don bsgrub pa skabs 'dir bya'o// gsum pa rjes la mchod pa kha gsos te/

rjes chog bya ba ni/ badzra sogs kyi dbang bskur ba dang rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgya dang*/ bsrung ba dang mchod pa rnams kun rig bzhin/ lha bcu gsum gyi bstod pa gong ltar bya/ dngos grub blang ba bdag bskyed bzhin/ yig brgya 'don zhing lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bshags nas/ brtan bzhugs bkra shis rnams kun rig bzhin bya'o// de rnams kyis kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas gzhir bzhag pa'i bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa ras bris la brten pa'i cho ga rdzogs par bstan zin to// brjod byed nyung ngu'i ngag gis cho ga'i lus// rdzogs par bde blag ston pa'i ngo mtshar 'di// rin chen sgron ma chung ngus 'khor yug gi /gzugs snang ltad mo ma bsgribs gsal ba mtshon// 'di bgyis dge ba'i 'chi med zil dngar gyis// 'gro kun nyi bu'i chad pa las grol nas// ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe dang 'bras bzang rnams// skabs gsum dbang po'i dpal la sgrun gyur cig /ces phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i ngag 'don gyi tho chung rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di'ang dbu mdzad bla ma kun dga' bsod nams dang dpal ldan phun tshogs dag gis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas 'phral du bris pa ka lyā ṇa bha wa tu// // ༄༅// phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ thub pa'i dbang po bcom ldan zas gtsang sras// gsang ba'i bdag po rab gsal zla ba dang*// sgra gcan 'dzin dpal kun dga' snying po'i zhabs// shes rab bskyangs dang pradzñā bo dhi pa// mukti ko ṣa dharma pā la dang*// dī paṃ ka ra go mi sgom chen zhabs// skyi nor dzñā na gnyal pa nyi she dang*// snur chen nyi 'od de sras rdo rje seng*// byang chub 'od dang nyi ma rgyal mtshan pa// ye shes rgyal mtshan chos 'phags rgyal mtshan zhabs// kun mkhyen 'phags 'od bu ston rin po che// rgyal mtshan grags pa bkra shis rin chen dang*// kun dga' bzang po mus chen sems dpa' che// sangs rgyas rin chen sangs rgyas seng ge dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang dpal ldan don kun grub// shes rab 'byung gnas lhun grub bkra shis dang*// kun dga' legs pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// kun dga' bstan 'dzin tshul khrims rin chen

yang na/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub bkra shis lhun gyis grub// tshul rin la sogs dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i sogs sbrel/ sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das// 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe rabs ring mo nas// tshe thung 'gyur ba'i las sgrib ci bsags pa// mkhyen brtse nus pa chen pos sbyong du gsol// bdag sogs mar gyur mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// 'chi bdag chad pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal nas// tshe dang las bzang bsod nams ye shes rgyas// mthar thug kun mkhyen thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad par chad 'dzud kha 'gengs dang bcas 'di mkhar mdo dbu mdzad ngag dbang bsod nams pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis zhus dag gi tshul du bgyis pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ /na mo gu ru badzra a yu ṣe/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// mtshams sbyor blo gsal kun dga' nyid// gzhir bzhag 'chi bdag 'joms pa yi// mi 'dra'i khyad par zur rgyan 'dri// 'dir kun rig dbang gi mtshams sbyor las/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor gyi dmigs bsal gyi kha bsgyur la/ gasnyen pa bskyal ba'i skabs/ de'i ched du 'chi bdag gi chad pa las thar bar bya ba'i phyir/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa sogs dang*/ rgyud nas bstan tshul bshad pa'i skabs/ rgyud de nyid kyi brtag pa phyi mas bstan pa tshe dang las dang bsod nams kyi tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar bgyi zhes bsgyur/

maṇḍal 'bul ba'i sngon du/ bla ma dang 'chi bdag 'joms pa tha mi dad pa la 'bul bar mos te maṇḍal/ rgyun bshags kyi sngon 'gror/ bdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sogs me tog bzung dor ti rinti'i phyag rgya byar gzhug lha ngo bstan pa'i skabs su/ de yang 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis spras pa dges pa'i bar dkyus ltar dang*/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar ram shar sngo skabs gang bab ltar brjod pa'i/ dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs dang*/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi dang sgo bzhir padma dang zla ba'i gdan re re dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin/ brten pa lha ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa sku mdog dkar po sogs nas bzhugs pa/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi'i shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan sogs nas bzhugs pa/ phyi'i grwa bzhi'i shar lho bdug spos ma nas dri chab ma/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma nas/ dril bu ma ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa/ bdug spos ma la sogs pa'i lha thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sogs nas bzhugs pa zhes dang*/ sgo ba bzhi po cung zad khro ba'i nyams dang ldan pa'o// bsdu na mtshan tsam brjod pas kyang rung ste gang ltar yang*/ brten pa lha ste/ mdor na bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum lta bur mthong ngo snyam pa'i dga' spro dang ldan pa'i sgo nas khyed rang gi me tog phog pa'i lha dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nyid yin pas/ de nyid mnyes pa'i thabs la brtson par mdzod ces dang*/ dam tshig bskyed pa'i skabs su rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying gar gtugs pas phyag na rdo rje snying la zhugs par mos/

zhes dang*/ sngags dbang gi skabs su mdun bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnam pa sngags rnams kyi yig 'bru gser btso ma'i mdog can dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rnams phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas tshe thog ma med pa nas tshe thung bar gyur pa'i las sgrib thams cad sbyang*/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ oṃ puṇye sogs brjod/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi skabs/ gnas skabs su 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po thob cing tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang mthar thug sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas chos kyi rgyal po 'chi bdag 'joms pa chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i slad du rin po che sna bdun sogs/ mjug tu de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod ces brjod la slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*// gzhan thams cad kun rig dbang gi mtshams sbyor dkyus ltar byas pas don grub bo// don gnyer dang po'i las can ngor// mtshams sbyor dmigs bsal tho chung 'di// bris pa'i dge bas mar gyur 'gro// som nyi'i 'ching ba grol phyir bsngo// zhes 'chi 'joms dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'di tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
